title: Cosmic Dog and Rocket Mouse
description: A large green dog with intricate patterns, a red eye, and a braided mane stands in a desert landscape, gazing at a broken yellow rocket ship. Above them, a glowing lightbulb contains a red mouse and a black cat, set against a vibrant purple and blue starry night sky with a full moon and satellite.
prompt: Surreal desert scene at night featuring a large ornate green dog with intricate floral patterns, red eye, and braided mane standing in profile and looking right. A broken yellow rocket ship with exposed panels and a satellite dish on top floats nearby. Inside a giant glowing lightbulb with blue electrical arcs above the rocket is a red mouse looking at a small black cat on a crescent moon. Full yellow moon in a swirling purple and blue cloudy sky, small black mouse running on a sand dune, whimsical and detailed digital painting style.
